{{Quote|When the dawn came the Zhell awakened and saw the Taungs upon the high place and were afraid, for the morning light caught the glint of helms and weapons and created phantom warriors, made of dazzle and distance. But the cleverest of them were not deceived, and saw how few we were. And so they assembled without haste, merry in mockery, and prepared to march. And in the high place we awaited death.|An excerpt from the ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]'' poetic epic|<ref name="TEGW" />}}
The "'''high place'''" was the name of an ancient [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in a [[Time/Legends|time]] long before the foundation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The fortress displayed the banners<ref name="TEGW" /> of [[Olhak the Reaver|Olhak]] the Reaver,<ref name="AncientCoruscant">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref> and was the gathering place of the Taung warriors under [[Rexutu the Unconquerable|Rexutu]] the Unconquerable as they prepared to [[Zhell–Taung war|clash]] with the [[Battalion/Legends|Battalions]] of [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] during the battle that would see the Taung take on the name of ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]''.<ref name="TEGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fortress known as the "high place" was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', co-[[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], and published [[April 3]], [[2012]].
